scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnce you leave this island there is no way back.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff一旦离开这座岛，就再也回不来了。

scripts.text: Are you sure you want to go directly to Izlude?^000000
scripts.translation: 你确定要直接前往依斯鲁得吗？^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffIf you do, the quest will be deleted from your Quest Log.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff如果这样做，任务将从你的任务日志中删除。^000000

scripts.text: Do not go to Izlude yet
You want to stay here longer?
scripts.translation: 你想在这里多待一会儿吗？

scripts.text: Good, then I'll wait until you're ready~
scripts.translation: 好的，那我会等你准备好再出发～
我们出发去依斯鲁得吧！
